title: situation.pickens_refusal_received.title

gate.none: Administrative correspondence only; no secession-cause claim, security order or protected-population policy or effect.

citations.at: I-4 p. 90, Army order of 12 March; pp. 109-111, Adams refusal of 1 April, Vogdes enclosure reports receipt the previous night, Welles 6 April acknowledges the dispatch; [I] thirty-one days from the opening 5 March choice to the recorded Navy receipt, shifted with a late choice; this aggregate correspondence interval does not claim a simulated ship or carrier

namedOnly: The Navy Department reports receipt of the cited Adams letter. Adams is the author of the historical enclosure, not a newly acting pack officeholder.
